paragraphs: Abba or Ada bar Avimi: [Eruvin 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.9b.12). Rav Tachlifa bar Avimi: [Pesachim 107a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.107a.6).[^1]

notes.text: Eruvin reads Rav Ada bar Avimi. In Pesachim, Rav Tachlifa bar Avimi speaks in the name of Shmuel.
